I really enjoyed my visit to this studio! Everything was clean and cozy, and the procedure itself was extremely comfortable.

A special thank you to Kwan – she's very sensitive, attentive, and caring. She constantly checked in to make sure everything was okay and tried to make the procedure as comfortable as possible.
I was also very pleased that Kwan speaks some Russian.

I definitely recommend her and will definitely be back!

The best hairstylist in Phuket is Kwan 👍
Special thanks to the salon owners, they respond incredibly well to feedback and improve the quality of their service every month. Awesome! …

I tried electrolysis for the first time. The technician, Yulia, was very polite, explained everything in detail, and provided advice. I'm especially glad that she has a medical degree. I decided to continue the treatment. Healing is going well, and the procedure itself was much less painful than I expected.

I was very pleased with my visit to the laser hair removal studio! Special thanks to Master Kwan. She was very attentive, meticulous, and professional. She explained everything thoroughly during the procedure, constantly asked how I was feeling, and made the process as comfortable as possible. I will definitely be back again and would highly recommend Master Kwan to anyone looking for high-quality laser hair removal!

I wish I could give 10 stars!

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the salon team, especially Kwan and Yulia.

Kwan has been performing laser hair removal procedures for me for many years. She has always been very professional, attentive, and kind. I'm a blonde, so laser hair removal can't remove some light and gray hairs, but thanks to Kwan, I was able to achieve excellent results in the areas where laser hair removal is effective.
It's clear that she is highly trained and truly knows her craft.

I recently started a course of electrolysis with Yulia and was truly impressed with her work.
Amazing!
Over the years, I've used various specialists both in Thailand and Russia, but I've rarely encountered such a level of professionalism, attentiveness, and care for the client.

Yulia is a top-notch specialist. The procedure was performed with the utmost care, comfort, and professionalism, all the explanations were clear, and her attitude was incredibly kind and compassionate. After my first visit, I booked my next session with Yulia without hesitation.

I sincerely hope the salon's management values ​​such employees. Kwan and Yulia are true professionals who make you want to come back again and again.

I really liked the hair removal, the price/quality ratio was excellent!
Excellent service, always quick responses, beautiful office, and a super professional. She worked on all areas very thoroughly, even asking about the power level and following all the procedure steps!
I'll be back, highly recommend!

It was the most amazing experience,
even though I had different specialists in Moscow and Vietnam.
I'm pleased with both the results and the procedure itself. It was the most gentle, careful, and pleasant laser hair removal experience. I'm very grateful to you.

I tried several laser hair removal studios in Phuket before finding this one, where I wanted to complete the course. The results are visible after the first few sessions, and I'm very pleased. The specialists are attentive, always explaining the process and reminding me about preparation. The office is always clean, everything is sterile, and the equipment is modern. The service is top-notch—it's a pleasure to come back. I definitely recommend it to anyone looking for laser hair removal!

I really liked everything! The specialist is very attentive, meticulous, and really takes time to work on each area—that's a big plus. I was absolutely delighted with this approach.

The results are immediately noticeable, which is especially pleasing. I go regularly and will happily continue!
This was my first time at this studio. It's cozy, the staff is polite and attentive. The results are excellent.
I had a pleasant experience here a month ago. The technician was very nice, friendly and put a lot of effort into ensuring my laser treatment was carried out well. I’ll be back next week.
I went for the first time, I liked everything, the specialist was wonderful, the procedure was painless and calm 🥰 I will definitely come back again! …
Excellent hair removal salon. Attentive staff, clean and tidy. They do fast, high-quality hair removal. Convenient location with ample parking.
Super quality and service! I 100% recommend it.

I went to this salon for electrolysis.
I was greeted by a very friendly and customer-oriented Thai woman💕

Unfortunately, that's where the positives ended!

Daria, a Russian-speaking technician, was waiting for me in the office. The negatives I've identified are:
1. Daria works without a change of clothes and without any forearm protection, even for personal hygiene. Her hands sticking to my body was incredibly unpleasant.
2. Daria took 28 minutes to complete a procedure that Russian technicians complete in 10 minutes. She's incredibly slow, which seems to be for her own self-serving reasons.
3. She doesn't pay attention to detail. The needle cord kept hitting my face, even though the procedure wasn't on my face. And until I covered my face with my hand, Daria didn't seem to notice; apparently, this is par for the course for her. I also asked that the lighting be adjusted so it wouldn't glare into my eyes and so she could see the area being treated.
4. The consumables are of the lowest quality. The cotton pads crumble on the skin, and before you could see if the job was done well, you had to roll off all the hair. Saving mere pennies on consumables = leaving a poor impression.
5. The treatment itself was also treated with inattention; visibly visible hairs were not removed from the treated area.

Overall, my conclusion is this:
The Russian-speaking "top specialist" Daria is not a top specialist. The Thai woman who greeted me at the entrance looked much more professional and neater than Daria. She probably deserves this star 🥲 Either Daria herself is just like that, or the level of service and safety of Russian specialists working in Thailand has sunk to the level of a local Thai eatery... sabai sabai...
I'm very glad I came for a trial treatment and not a full one.
I can't recommend this salon. Naturally, I won't be returning either.

I wish you success, prosperity, and continued work on improving your service 🌷

Yes! Yes! And yes again! Instagram's algorithms suggested this place as a solution to my ingrown hair problem, as well as to other areas where they cause discomfort! And it was the best decision to immediately contact you for help! …

The best salon with Russian service! I'll only go here now. They do it very carefully. Just like in Moscow. I wish there were more salons like this with such high-quality service, from the appointment to the quality of the procedure! I have something to compare it to in Phuket for laser hair removal. I definitely recommend this clinic!

Today I had a laser hair removal treatment.
Underarms + bikini area. 30% off your first visit.
Everything went great. The technician was incredibly pleasant, and she carefully asked how I was feeling, whether it was painful, and whether I needed to increase or decrease the power. She did everything thoroughly.
The salon is clean and cozy. They use a diode laser. You can find more information on their Instagram.
Overall, I recommend this salon ☺️

I go to Master K for electrolysis. The procedure itself isn't the most pleasant, but it's quite easy thanks to the kind and friendly atmosphere. Everything is sterile, and the electrolysis needle is disposable and is opened in front of you. A cozy studio, thank you so much 🙏🏼 …

I've been to this salon three times already. I get laser treatments. I noticed results after my first visit! The salon is well-renovated, everything is neat. They offer refreshments. There are instructions on the walls to make communication with the technicians easier. The technicians themselves are wonderful. I've been to two of them, and both are wonderful and sweet. I feel very comfortable and relaxed during the treatments. I also like the communication with the manager on Instagram. She responds very quickly. I recommend this salon and will continue to go there myself.
The brilliant on the island
Thanks to Zum, the specialist, she approached the procedure very professionally and customer-oriented 🙏🏼 …

This is my third time visiting this laser hair removal salon and I was so pleased I decided to leave a review. My therapist was Thai, who was trained by a Russian specialist during one of my sessions. The Russian specialist explained the procedure in detail, answered all my questions, and created a very comfortable atmosphere. The Thai woman who trained me was simply amazing—sweet, attentive, and very thorough. She performed the procedure with utmost care.
The salon itself is clean, cozy, and has a pleasant interior. The equipment is modern and high-quality. We scheduled my appointment promptly, and everything was on time. The online managers are efficient, responding quickly and answering any questions.
I noticed results after the first treatment, as my hair began to grow more slowly and thinner, and after the third, I was absolutely delighted!
I plan to complete the entire course and confidently recommend this salon, as I know how difficult it is to find a salon that works for me abroad.

Finding your perfect beauty specialist is no easy task. And it's even more challenging abroad.
Every woman knows how important it is to find a specialist who is 100% satisfactory. Even in Russia, this can be challenging, and even more so abroad. We often rely on Russian-speaking specialists—it seems safer and more familiar.

Living in Phuket, I also initially looked only for Russian specialists. But with each visit, I'm increasingly convinced: the best beauty specialists here are Thai.
They work incredibly meticulously, carefully, and with a genuine love for detail. They do everything meticulously and with an attitude as if the result is more important to them than to the client. They truly care about the final result, striving to achieve perfection—and this is felt in every touch.

That's why after such procedures, only positive emotions and a deep sense of care remain.
I was lucky to find such specialists. And now, if someone asks for a recommendation, I will definitely say: only to Thai women ❤️
Very happy with the service here. Had laser hair removal done on several areas and would definitely recommend coming here. Felt very comfortable and well taken care of.
Excellent job! I've had it done before. The master stylist did a great job. The service was excellent, friendly, clean, and the results were truly great.
Best of the best laser master .She is very professional and very convenience for client .After one month I will be come back and see more comfortable for me.Her name is Zum.
Very professional laser hair removal master,nice place , i was second time , results best of the best, ill be back 💖 …
I had laser hair removal done by a Thai woman. Their English isn't great, but the procedure itself was very high-quality.
